scope: Distinguish ACadRust ACIS parsing and carrier round-trip evidence from a potential OpenCADKernel geometry comparison; refine only existing optional semantic gates.

method.kind: Public primary repository README, manifest, source, test, and consumer-route review
method.evidenceBoundary: Selected ACadRust parser, builder, manifest, and round-trip test paths establish an implemented ACIS code surface and generated self-tests, but not independent-profile coverage or closed-solid semantics. OpenCADKernel documents an ACIS-to-B-rep route and a separate kernel, while also declaring early maturity and depending on the ACadRust-derived codec. OpenCADStudio documents a kernel-first route with incomplete per-surface fallback. No exact peer binary, external payload, independent geometry result, full source audit, DWG AcDs join, or native acceptance was established.

findings.topic: ACadRust has source-level ACIS parsing/building, but reviewed DWG tests prove carrier presence rather than independent solid semantics
observed: ACadRust 0.6.4 is published as MPL-2.0 and contains dedicated SAT/SAB parser, primitive-builder, and writer modules.
Inspected SAT parser tests exercise handcrafted v4/v7 text records and a synthetic box; planar-body builder tests verify a generated cube's topology counts and manifold validation.
The reviewed AC1032 DWG round-trip test generates a planar body and asserts the returned entity still has ACIS data; it does not compare decoded record graphs or independent geometric metrics.
The fake SAB helper is described as a minimal envelope with ASM signature, arbitrary tagged bytes, and terminator, not as a semantic solid payload.
doesNotEstablish: independently produced SAT/SAB parser correctness across producer/version profiles
a semantic SAB round trip, closed-solid validity, or independent volume/topology match
independent DWG/DXF reader lineage for OpenCADStudio, CADCraft, or ACadRust forks
correct source-handle-to-AcDs payload association for libdxfrw output
findings.planUse: Keep ACadRust in the existing codec-family comparator role. At the optional composed gate, capture codec, bare-payload parser, carrier/owner association, and geometry results separately; own-codec round-trip or non-empty carrier is not semantic proof.

findings.topic: OpenCADKernel is a conditional non-OCCT geometry route, not a new parser or ready mandatory gate
observed: OpenCADKernel documents lifting ACadRust SatDocument into its own B-rep, while explicitly describing the project as early and saying most operations remain unwritten.
Its optional ACIS feature depends on the ACadRust-derived opencadcodec package at a pinned Git revision.

OpenCADStudio documents kernel B-rep lift and per-face triangulation for ACIS, with an incomplete per-surface LOD fallback when a face cannot be lifted; it identifies its codec lineage separately from the kernel route.
doesNotEstablish: a verified implementation of any specific target operation at a pinned release
independent DWG/DXF/AcDs decoding or an independent parser vote
complete shape semantics when the renderer invokes surface fallback
an executed valid-solid result or support qualification
findings.planUse: Retain only as a conditional, one-time second-kernel comparison at the existing composed checkpoint. Pin kernel, codec, dependency resolution, features and toolchain; preflight the exact operation; require full no-fallback topology and independent analytic metrics. If unavailable, record NOT_AVAILABLE and continue local implementation.

findings.topic: cq-acis adds a profile-bounded parser route but not a second kernel lineage from FreeCAD
observed: The README identifies the parser/converter as experimental, declares SAT save versions 105, 400, 600, and 700 plus selected SAB/ASM profiles, and says unsupported records remain raw while failed shape conversion raises an error.

The checked-in corpus manifest records ezdxf-origin cube SAT/SAB files with upstream commit, license notice, and SHA256, which improves reproducibility but does not make that producer independent of ezdxf-authored fixtures.
The geometry conversion route uses CadQuery/OpenCASCADE, sharing kernel lineage with FreeCAD.
doesNotEstablish: an independently authored expected solid merely by parsing a fixture from the peer corpus
a second kernel result separate from OCCT or FreeCAD
findings.planUse: Retain cq-acis only in its existing optional distinct-parser role. At the existing composed checkpoint, pin version/dependencies and profile, do not import its corpus into local fixtures, separate parser results from OCCT shape results, and compare against locally authored expectations.

existingOwnersOnly: S3/S5/S8 semantic and consumer evidence gates
nextActions: Continue the existing local fast implementation queue; do not add peer setup or runtime to per-slice work.
At the existing composed checkpoint only, consider OpenCADKernel if the exact build and scoped operation are available or explicitly selected.
Keep codec/carrier, bare SAT/SAB parse, kernel B-rep, and renderer/fallback outcomes separate.
Require independently authored geometry expectations and complete no-fallback topology/metric results before considering a kernel comparison informative.
Keep source-handle-to-AcDs association as a separate requirement for any DWG-origin case.
